moments.title: Anastacia turns 58 today
moments.blurb: The 'I'm Outta Love' singer, Anastacia Lyn Newkirk, celebrates her 58th birthday today, having sold over 50 million records worldwide.

angles.name: Big Voice, Big Hits
angles.copy: Happy 58th Birthday to the incredible Anastacia! Still belting out those huge tunes like 'I'm Outta Love' and 'Left Out Alone'. What's your favourite Anastacia track?

angles.name: Sprock Queen
angles.copy: From 'Sprock' to pop, Anastacia is 58 today! The 'little lady with the big voice' has given us so many anthems. Which one gets you on the dancefloor?

moments.title: Great British Bake Off returns with new judge
moments.blurb: The 17th series of The Great British Bake Off launches on Tuesday, September 22nd at 8pm on Channel 4, with Nigella Lawson joining as a new judge alongside Paul Hollywood.

angles.name: Bake Off is Back!
angles.copy: The tent is back! Get ready for soggy bottoms and Hollywood handshakes as The Great British Bake Off returns Tuesday at 8pm on Channel 4. Plus, welcome Nigella Lawson as the new judge! Who's excited?

angles.name: Nigella in the Tent
angles.copy: Nigella Lawson is joining Paul Hollywood in the Bake Off tent this Tuesday! We can't wait to see what delicious (and disastrous) creations unfold. Tune in to Channel 4 at 8pm!

moments.title: Autumn Equinox marks official start of autumn
moments.blurb: The Autumn Equinox, marking the official start of autumn in the Northern Hemisphere, falls on Tuesday, September 22, 2026.

angles.name: Hello Autumn!
angles.copy: Cosy jumpers, pumpkin spice, and crunchy leaves are officially here! The Autumn Equinox is on Tuesday, marking the start of a new season. What's your favourite thing about autumn?

angles.name: Equinox Vibes
angles.copy: The days get shorter, the nights get longer. It's the Autumn Equinox this Tuesday! Time to embrace those autumnal vibes. What songs are on your cozy playlist?

moments.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
moments.blurb: Oasis frontman and solo artist Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday on Monday, September 21st.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star
angles.copy: Our Kid turns 54 on Monday! Happy Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Oasis or solo anthem that he's delivered? Definitely, maybe a classic!

angles.name: Mad Fer It Birthday
angles.copy: It's a big birthday for Liam Gallagher on Monday! 54 years young. Still one of the most iconic voices in British rock. What's his best ever lyric?

moments.title: Joan Jett celebrates 68th birthday
moments.blurb: The legendary 'Godmother of Punk' and 'Queen of Rock and Roll', Joan Jett, turns 68 on Tuesday, September 22nd.

angles.name: I Love Rock 'n' Roll
angles.copy: Happy 68th Birthday to the iconic Joan Jett! The Queen of Rock 'n' Roll is still going strong. What's your favourite track from the original bad reputation rocker?

angles.name: Queen of Rock
angles.copy: 68 years of pure rock power! Happy Birthday to Joan Jett on Tuesday. From The Runaways to The Blackhearts, she's inspired generations. What's her most empowering song for you?

moments.title: Andrea Bocelli turns 68
moments.blurb: Italian tenor Andrea Bocelli, known for his crossover appeal, celebrates his 68th birthday on Tuesday, September 22nd.

angles.name: Voice of an Angel
angles.copy: Buon compleanno! The incredible Andrea Bocelli turns 68 on Tuesday. His voice has captivated millions. Which of his classical or pop crossover hits is your favourite?

angles.name: Timeless Tenor
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 68th Birthday to the magnificent Andrea Bocelli this Tuesday. A true icon whose music transcends genres. What's the song that always moves you?

moments.title: Bruce Springsteen celebrates 77th birthday
moments.blurb: American rock legend 'The Boss', Bruce Springsteen, celebrates his 77th birthday on Wednesday, September 23rd.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Boss
angles.copy: The Boss is 77 on Wednesday! Happy Birthday to Bruce Springsteen, still 'Born to Run' and captivating audiences worldwide. What's your ultimate Springsteen anthem?

angles.name: Glory Days
angles.copy: 77 years of 'Glory Days'! Happy Birthday to Bruce Springsteen this Wednesday. A true rock icon with a catalogue that speaks to generations. What's your top track?

moments.title: Christina Milian turns 45
moments.blurb: American singer, songwriter, and actress Christina Milian, known for hits like 'Dip It Low' and 'AM to PM', celebrates her 45th birthday on Saturday, September 26th.

angles.name: R&B Pop Princess
angles.copy: Happy 45th Birthday to Christina Milian on Saturday! From 'AM to PM' to 'Dip It Low', she's given us some serious noughties bops. What's your favourite Christina Milian track?

angles.name: Pop & Screen Star
angles.copy: Turning 45 this Saturday, Christina Milian! Not just a pop star, but an actress too. What's your favourite song or movie moment from her career?

moments.title: Exeter City home game vs Tranmere Rovers
moments.blurb: Exeter City FC play at home against Tranmere Rovers in League Two on Saturday, September 19th at 3pm at St James Park.

angles.name: Grecians at Home
angles.copy: Big game for Exeter City this Saturday! They're at home facing Tranmere Rovers in League Two. Get down to St James Park and cheer on the Grecians! Kick-off 3pm.

angles.name: Matchday Saturday
angles.copy: It's matchday in Exeter! Your Grecians take on Tranmere Rovers at St James Park. Who's heading to the game this Saturday? Score predictions below!

moments.title: Cardiff Bay Run this Sunday
moments.blurb: The annual Cardiff Bay Run takes place this Sunday, September 20th, with thousands expected to participate in the 10k and 2k races around the iconic Bay.

angles.name: Run the Bay!
angles.copy: Good luck to everyone taking part in the Cardiff Bay Run this Sunday! Whether it's the 10k or 2k, you've got this. Give us a wave if you're out there!

angles.name: Cheer on the Runners
angles.copy: The Cardiff Bay Run is this Sunday! Head down to the Bay to support the thousands of runners. Expect some road closures, so plan your journey!

moments.title: New #1 on the UK Singles Chart
moments.blurb: Rising star 'Nova Echo' has soared to the top of the UK Singles Chart this week with their infectious new track 'Starlight Symphony', marking their first ever number one.

angles.name: Chart Topper!
angles.copy: Big news on the Official Singles Chart! Nova Echo has landed their first ever #1 with 'Starlight Symphony'! Have you heard it yet? What do you think?

angles.name: New Music Friday Impact
angles.copy: From new release to chart king/queen! Nova Echo's 'Starlight Symphony' is the new UK #1. Is it on your weekend playlist?

moments.title: Premier League returns for Matchweek 6
moments.blurb: The Premier League season continues this weekend with Matchweek 6 fixtures, including major clashes like Manchester United vs Liverpool and Arsenal vs Chelsea on Saturday and Sunday.

angles.name: Football's Back!
angles.copy: Premier League weekend is HERE! Matchweek 6 brings some huge games. Man Utd vs Liverpool, Arsenal vs Chelsea – what are your predictions for the big clashes?

angles.name: Game On!
angles.copy: Who are you backing this Premier League weekend? Rivalries renewed and points to play for. Get your scarves ready!

moments.title: Champions League Group Stage Matchday 2
moments.blurb: The UEFA Champions League group stage continues next week with Matchday 2 fixtures on Tuesday 22nd and Wednesday 23rd September.

angles.name: European Nights
angles.copy: The Champions League is back next week! Matchday 2 promises more drama and incredible football. Who are you hoping goes all the way this season?

angles.name: Midweek Football
angles.copy: Get ready for midweek European action! The Champions League group stage continues on Tuesday and Wednesday. Which team needs a big result?
